reason: The previous retrospective audit used row-order tie breaking for tied Ability/M3 scores. TARGET result exports can be finish-order sorted, so current finish order could leak into tied ranks. Date parsing and numeric race-ID coercion also dropped/misordered some historical rows. Production runtime itself was not affected.

ui_policy.partner_rank: Do not present Ability-only order as validated CORE/BACKUP betting order.
ui_policy.ability_m3_p10: Display as structural traits only while opponent order is revalidated.
ui_policy.market: Final-popularity proxy was the strongest simple retrospective comparator, but exact T-15 validation is unavailable and therefore no production ranking is promoted.
ui_policy.pair_price: No stable Ability-pair odds threshold was found.

caveats: This compatibility file exists so older UI code cannot continue showing the superseded 84%/98% Ability capture claims.
Use opponent_rank_audit_v2.json for full corrected methodology, partner statistics and price-band diagnostics.
